ok.description: True only when all required stages and finalizers succeeded.

routine_id.description: The declaration namespace owning the chord.

stages.description: Ordered serve and finally outcomes, including skipped stages and each returned receipt.

failedStage.description: First required or finalizer stage that refused, or null.

firstMissingSignal.description: First failure signal, or none on success.

changed.description: Present only when every mutating stage reported whether it changed.
